The Deeplings world change decides how much of {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja}, the underwater city of the {wiki:Deeplings|Deeplings} in Quirefang, is accessible. It has 3 stages: in stage 1 (the normal one) only a small part of Fiehonja is open; in stage 3 you have access to the whole zone. Players advance the stages with the missions of the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest|Liquid Black Quest}.

This world change revolves around a quest: all the detailed steps (how to get there, what to do in each mission) are in the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest|Liquid Black Quest} guide. Here we only explain how the stages work.
In Fiehonja you face all kinds of {wiki:Deeplings|Deeplings}.

The Deeplings world change takes place in {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja} (Quirefang) and has **3 stages**. Stage 1 is the default and almost nothing in Fiehonja is accessible. Each following stage opens more area, and at **stage 3** you have access to the whole zone.
Only a small part of Fiehonja
The stage goes up when the players on the server gather **200 points** with the missions of the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest|Liquid Black Quest}. The available missions change depending on the stage.
Soul Net (5 points); killing a {creature:Deepling Guard} (1 point up to 100 points, then about 0.1)
Same as stage 1 + Coral Mine (2 points per coral box)
There is no stage 4. If 200 points are gathered on the last day of stage 3, the world change goes back to stage 2 instead of dropping to stage 1.

Go to {wiki:Gray Island|Gray Island} (boats only from Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Darashia and Edron). There you can talk to {npc:Scrutinon} about Quirefang. Then follow the first part of the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest|Liquid Black Quest} guide (The First Visitor) to reach {wiki:Gray Beach|Gray Beach} and receive the equipment that lets you go underwater in Fiehonja.
Route summary: at the port say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} (150 gp); on Gray Island enter the hole **south** of Scrutinon, head **northeast** on floor -1 and enter the {item:Water Vortex}; on the other side use the {item:Rope} on the ground spot and head **north** to Gray Beach. For Fiehonja, enter the hole furthest **southeast** on Gray Beach and go down the giant staircase (or, once you have done the Liquid Black Quest shortcut, use the Gray Beach teleport, which leaves you next to Qjell's statue).
Hole south-east of Gray Beach (to Fiehonja)

To leave, return to Gray Beach through the shortcut teleport (or go back up the staircase) and do the arrival route in reverse to Gray Island, where you take the boat to Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Darashia or Edron. The wiki says Gray Island is the only known way to reach Gray Beach.
Do the missions of the current stage

Do the missions available in the stage your server is on (see the table above). Each one adds points for the server to reach 200 and open the next stage, and also gives Liquid Black Quest rewards (including the {wiki:Deepling Outfits|Deepling Outfit} and addons).
For all the mission steps, see the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest|Liquid Black Quest} guide.
